title: Did You See These?!
content:
Photo by John Jewell, via Flckr (https://www.flickr.com/photos/shstrng/)

Here's a few recent MeFi posts you might have missed:

  • Chavenet shared the continued hilarity of hitting reply all on a large email list.

  • Mittens shared a link about the evil nerds that are causing your high power bill. There really is a cabal!

  • Rcraniac posted several links about the gift economy and gift thinking

  • GCU Sweet and Full of Grace noted Amazon is ending downloads for Kindle. BOOO!
author: Brandon Blatcher
